text:
devon: PR #8742 is blocked on architecture sign-off. RFC anchor: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/rfc/INF-312. Hoping to merge tomorrow (afternoon PST) if we get an ack.

maria: do we have an SLO delta? any perf regressions expected? :thinking:

devon: SLO impact estimated +2-3ms p50 on cold path; no throughput hit. Ran perf microbench with quantized model, numbers attached in PR. Also requires a small routing tweak (shard affinity change).

ben: please add the RFC link into the PR description and include the rollout plan. @arch-ptl can you weigh in? this touches routing and fallback behavior.

arch-ptl: I can review tomorrow morning. quick skim now — we need an explicit canary plan + a fallback policy in the PR. Also add expected monitoring signals and thresholds.

devon: copying proposed canary into the PR description now. rough plan below:
```
- Deploy variant to 5% traffic for 2h
- Monitor token latency (p50/p95) and error rate every 5m
- If latency delta > 10ms OR error rate spike > 0.5% rollback to previous routing
- After 2h with no regressions, ramp to 25% for 1h then full rollout
```

jen: heads up — we have a release tonight. this change can't go into tonight's cut. what's the earliest merge window after arch ack?

devon: not tonight — earliest is tomorrow 15:00 PST after arch ack + green CI. I'll coordinate with release-ops once we have sign-off.

ci-bot: Lint failed on this branch — run `./tools/lint` and push fixes. :robot_face:

devon: fixing lint now, pushing an update in ~10m. will add the canary + fallback details to the PR description as requested. pinging @arch-ptl when done.

arch-ptl: sounds good. once lint is green and the canary/fallback notes are in the PR description I'll prioritize a quick review. please also include the exact metrics dashboard link so on-call can watch during the canary. :thumbsup:
